lifecycle.notes: Pinned variant: Purina Pro Plan Adult 7+ Complete Essentials Chicken & Rice Entree (Classic pate, senior) wet dog food, 13-oz cans; can UPC 038100190376. Not the regular Adult Classic Chicken & Rice (Chewy 1783838 / Walmart 22068937), not Senior Beef & Rice, not Savory Meals, not 3-oz/5.5-oz cans. For Alexey's dog Mattia, ZIP 32095. Case of 4 (4 x 13 oz). Price rows are per case of 4; per-can = price/4. Only Chewy sells a 4-can case: Amazon B08XN4WHH3 twister offers only case of 12 and pack of 24; Walmart 20480254543 '(4 pack) ... 13 oz Can (12 Pack)' is 4 x 12-packs (48 cans), dropped; Target does not carry it; Petco blocked by DataDome captcha; purina.com 'temporarily unavailable' on 2026-10-10.

cons: Easy to confuse with regular Adult Classic Chicken & Rice and the Senior Beef & Rice cans
pros: Real chicken first ingredient, formulated for dogs 7+
Picky senior dogs reportedly eat it readily; vet-recommended per reviewers
No artificial colors, flavors or preservatives; 23 vitamins and minerals
reviews.summary: Chewy shows 4.6/5 from 1631 ratings on the shared Adult 7+ Chicken & Rice Entree listing (case of 4 and case of 12); Amazon shows 4.5/5 from 668 ratings on B08XN4WHH3. Amazon's review summary says dogs find it tasty (including picky eaters), with mixed feedback on digestibility and on value for money.
